verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask of an AI gateway, but the evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Related features such as named gateway IDs, A/B and gradual rollouts via dynamic routing, and per-request log or payload controls are adjacent and are not sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
